text:
noah.turner: FYI TideBridge wants a 4-week pilot for a payments-fraud assistant + decisioning hook. Kickoff Thu 9am PT with their product + security. Need to agree POC scope: success KPIs, golden prompt bank, scoring, regression gates, infra/pricing options, and SQ blockers. Who picks up the harness?

priya.singh: I can run the harness and author the goldens. Request: they provide 40-60 anonymized chat+transaction samples and a ranked list of 12 fraud types. Also need a sample throughput profile (avg TPS, peak TPS).

jack.chen: I'll design the scoring. Proposal: two-pass eval: automated metrics + sampled human review. Candidate metrics: Top1 accuracy (fraud label), Precision@1, Explanation quality (0-3), Suggested action correctness (0-2). Weighted score = 0.6*Top1 + 0.3*Explanation + 0.1*Action. Pass if weighted >= 0.75.

mike.reynolds: Important: deployment choice drives cost. If they insist on customer-managed KMS + HSM and on-prem, add ~3 weeks setup. Quick estimate: hosted pilot (best-effort) = $6-10k for 4 weeks; Dedicated VPC pilot (reserve) = ~$18-30k/mo equivalent; Private on-prem = quoting separately. I'll send a short spreadsheet.

lena.kovacs: SQ highlights to confirm: PII in samples (masked? tokenized?), retention window, right-to-erasure process, access controls, audit log retention, KMS ownership. If they want live transaction samples, require legal signoff and DPA addendum.

secops-bot: SQ template v2 available at https://redwood/sq-templates. Post completed draft to #eng-security for review.

priya.singh: Golden prompt seeds (we'll expand to 250 total; these are seeds to cover core flows):
```
G001: "A cardholder reports 3 declined transactions from unknown devices within 10 minutes; summarize risk and recommended block/verify step."
G002: "Given transaction record {amount, merchant_category, device_age, ip_risk_score}: classify FRAUD/OK and list top 2 contributing features."
G003: "Customer disputes a charge labeled as possible fraud; generate a short script for agent to collect proof (2 questions)."
```

priya.singh: Also including a few adversarial cases: split transactions, synthetic identities, chargeback disputes. Need to seed those intentionally.

jack.chen: Scoring rubric (concrete): Top1 label exact match (1/0), Explanation coherence (0-2), Signal citation (0-2), Action clarity (0-1). Auto-score on label + explanation similarity (embedding cosine > 0.78) and human review for low-confidence. Regression gate: nightly baseline run; fail if weighted score drops >4% absolute or Top1 drops >6% relative.

mike.reynolds: For sizing: pilot baseline 25 TPS sustained, spikes 120 TPS -> recommend Dedicated pool with autoscale headroom ~6 GPUs (A100 equiv) for headroom. If they only do hosted eval with sampling, we can run smaller and replay offline.

lena.kovacs: Also: require confirmation on log retention: dev logs must be masked and retained <30 days for pilot. Ask if they require PCI-specific controls beyond standard data handling.

noah.turner: Agenda for Thu kickoff: 1) confirm use cases + golden dataset owner; 2) data sharing & masking rules; 3) deployment preference + SLA targets; 4) pricing ballpark and timeline; 5) success metrics + gating; 6) security questionnaire timeline.

priya.singh: Proposed timeline (4 weeks): Week0: kickoff + data transfer (anonymized); Week1: harness ingest + seed goldens; Week2: baseline eval + prompt tuning; Week3: robustness/adversarial + regression runs; Week4: handoff + runbook and recommendation.

jack.chen: Automation note: will add nightly cron job that produces a regression digest; if gate trips, open a PR to revert prompt/model with human sign-off required.

noah.turner: Action items: - @noah.turner request 50 sample transcripts + fraud typology from TideBridge by Tue EOD - @mike.reynolds share cost spreadsheet by Tue noon - @lena.kovacs list SQ mandatory fields and risk items by Tue noon - @priya.singh create initial goldens skeleton by Wed noon - @jack.chen wire up scoring pipeline skeleton this week

lena.kovacs: I'll also ask legal about accepting masked PAN fragments vs full tokens. Likely need DPA/EU SCCs for their region.

secops-bot: Note: requesting HSM-managed keys triggers Private option; onboarding timeline + compliance review may extend pilot.

priya.singh: One more: For the golden set we should tag each sample with expected label, severity (low/med/high), and whether its adversarial. That helps weighted sampling during nightly runs.

jack.chen: Agree. We'll keep a baseline snapshot artifact (sha256) of the goldens + scoring config to detect unintended edits.

noah.turner: Great. I'll send invites and ask TideBridge to confirm samples + SLA. Closing thread until kickoff prep updates. Thanks everyone :rocket:
